caption: The video showcases a top-down view of a wooden floor arranged with domino art spelling DOMINOES in black pieces inside white rectangular outlines, a VS in the center, and MACHINES below in mixed yellow, white, red and black dominoes. Small black pips sit above the horizontal bar in each top letter. A blue L-shaped piece sits at the far left edge, a long white line runs down the right side linking the two words, and horizontal domino strips flank the VS. The overhead framing remains stable across the views. The letters, outlines, screws, red curved C, transparent lower loops, and connecting lines appear to hold the same visible arrangement, with no clear deformation or displacement of the first D or adjacent O outline. The final views show the same constructed arrangement.
